analysis.caveat: Fresh same-node run (ctr-s93-mi300x-21). Kernels VERIFIED via the per-kernel launch table — attention kernels selected (101 launches each), copyBuffer/init helpers excluded. rocprofv3 --pmc, 100 iters, bf16 Sq8192. ISA via llvm-objdump --mcpu=gfx942.

counters.read: static descriptor; AITER=0 but uses DYNAMIC LDS (ISA: ds_read 40 + ds_write 20)

analysis.takeaway: AITER is NOT LDS-free — its ISA issues ds_read(40) + ds_write(20) + ds_bpermute(2); the static LDS descriptor reads 0 only because Triton allocates LDS DYNAMICALLY at launch (rocprofv3's static LDS_Block_Size field misses it). The ~1.56x gap is OCCUPANCY + MFMA UTILIZATION: OURS uses a 34 KB STATIC LDS + 2x workgroup (512 vs 256) → 4.9 waves/CU and 22% MFMA util with ~2x wait cycles; AITER's smaller (dynamic) LDS + WG=256 → 6.4 waves/CU and 37.7% MFMA util (same 64 v_mfma). Lever: SHRINK ours' LDS footprint / workgroup to raise occupancy — not 'avoid LDS'.
